content:
Hello, I am experiencing an issue with Onimator, and I am hoping you can help me find a solution. I have been running IG accounts for a few months and at the start it seemed to be fine and everything worked.

However, now when I run the program, it will start an action and then get stuck "waiting for keyword posts feed to load" or "waiting for post likes to load". So it can start running, but will instantly get stuck on the first action it takes. I will attach a picture below of what the log looks like and how it gets stuck.

I have tried restarting devices, uninstalling the program, deleting old files, updating the bot, and reconnecting the device and accounts to the bot.

Please let me know if there is a way to resolve this. I want to continue using this service, but if it continues to encounter issues, I will have no choice but to explore alternative routes. Thank you for taking the time to help. Please get back to me as soon as you can!
